technical_quality: Adequate PA film, L marker upper image-right confirms conventional orientation, no rotation, adequate inspiration, right shoulder abducted with humerus/scapula overlapping right upper chest wall, mild soft-tissue overlap laterally

devices.location: right axilla and right upper lateral chest wall, projecting partly over right upper zone (prior axillary lymph node dissection)
image upper right corner, over patient's left shoulder
image upper right corner, over patient's left shoulder below L marker

abnormalities.finding: small rounded gas lucency in the retrocardiac left paraspinal region at the level of the medial left hemidiaphragm, questionable small hiatal hernia versus gastric fundus below the diaphragm
absent right breast shadow with markedly increased lucency of the right hemithorax compared with the left, consistent with prior right mastectomy (with right axillary surgical clips)
prominent, unfolded aortic knob / tortuous thoracic aorta (age-related)

description_zh: PA正面胸部X光，L標記位於影像右側，投照方位正常，吸氣程度尚可。心影後方、左側脊柱旁靠近左橫膈內側處可見一小型含氣透亮區，疑似小型食道裂孔疝氣，但影像上並不明確，無法排除為橫膈下之胃底氣體。右側腋下及右上胸壁可見多枚呈弧形排列之手術夾，右側乳房陰影消失且右側胸腔透亮度明顯較左側增加，符合右側乳房切除及腋下淋巴結廓清術後變化。主動脈弓突出、迂曲，雙肺無明顯實質病灶，未見肋膜積液或氣胸，亦未見胸管或引流管。
